snippet.title: 【Beat The Beat! : Rhythm Action】Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
In a world that lost its music after the invasion of the mysterious beat monsters known as B-MO, begin an adventure with the Muses, mystical beings born from the will of musical instruments, and restore music to the world once more!

■ Pulse-pounding beats, exhilarating rhythm action, and special abilities!
Feel the rush of vibrant music, powerful action, and thrilling rhythm gameplay!
Use the unique skills of your Muses to overcome obstacles and aim for the highest score!

■ Easy to pick up, fun with gestures!
Tap notes are only the beginning! Swipe up and down to the beat!
Packed with easy yet addictive songs that even rhythm game newcomers can enjoy!
Featuring tracks and chart designs by a wide range of rhythm game composers and pattern designers.

■ Grow together with your Muses!
Collect and upgrade a variety of Muses that become even more special and powerful as they grow,
and uncover their hidden stories!

■ A variety of game modes!
Enjoy a wealth of content, including Daily Training mini-games played to the music,
Challenge mode where everyone competes under the same conditions,
and Contest mode where you face off against other players!

■ Gather together for boss raids!
Choose from a variety of abilities and respond to the boss’s disruptive skills!
Creatively combine the many skills of your Muses
and experience the strategic fun of overcoming the boss’s attack patterns!

*Includes randomized items.


■ DOWNLOAD NOW ■
Google Play : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BePex.beatthebeat&hl=en_US
App Store : https://apps.apple.com/sg/app/beat-the-beat-rhythm-action/id6444065575
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/beatthebeat.btb/
